Welcome to a place for animal lovers who want more than meds when helping pets to recover from injuries or cope with health conditions. 

You’ll be able to follow some of my patients through rehab - the first one is my own dog, Louis, who's recovering from a big abdominal surgery, as well as having arthritis in his elbows. 

I work mainly with dogs and horses, but treat all kinds of animals, including cats, sheep, alpaca, goats and cows. You'll also see clips helping you to identify when your animals are in pain, and showing you ways you can help them. They don't deserve to hurt, and there's no place for pain.

I'm a rehab vet with postgrad training (and more than 18 years of experience) in veterinary rehabilitation, veterinary acupuncture, animal chiropractic, osteopathy, saddle fitting and more. My clients and their animals get great results when we work together to improve their lives with rehab. I'm your creaky joints vet!
